proposal.summary: The original request (SH-CS, CL-01/CL-03) asked for an AI assistant to draft apology replies to customers complaining of double charges. Investigation under PD-1 instead traced the real problem to a 2026-09-09 gateway change: SH-PAY disabled idempotency-key enforcement on capture retries (CHG-77) to debug latency and never rolled it back (E-01), causing the PSP to stop deduplicating timeout retries and post a second real capture on about 4% of daily orders (E-02, E-03), which drove the double-charge ticket surge from 9-11/week to 288-301/week starting the week of 09-09 (E-04). The hypothesis H-IDEMPOTENCY-DISABLED was confirmed and the apology-reply framing (H-COMMUNICATION-GAP, H-COMPLAINT-SCALE-OVERSTATED) was rejected as not addressing root cause. The release decision is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION: it covers confirming the current runtime setting (SH-OPS), verifying duplicate-capture resolution against the charge ledger, and assessing ticket normalization, but does NOT include actually re-enabling idempotency enforcement, which remains blocked pending verification that the gateway-config tool is operational.
key_points: Root cause chain established via config audit (E-01), capture counts matching timeout retries only after 09-09 (E-02), PSP dedup working only when the idempotency key is present (E-03), and the ticket surge timing (E-04).

Hypothesis H-IDEMPOTENCY-DISABLED was CONFIRMED by E-01, E-02, E-03, E-04, E-05, E-07, E-08; the originally requested apology-reply tool (CL-01/CL-03) was rejected as a root-cause fix because it does not change the duplicate-capture rate.

The protected action set_capture_idempotency requires runtime confirmation by SH-OPS per constraint K-GW and the payments runbook (E-07); re-enabling the setting itself is NOT part of what was released.
payments-db shows 4 currently open, unrefunded duplicate-capture orders as of 2026-10-09 (O-90211, O-90244, O-90302, O-90318, total $227.40) per E-08.
Re-enabling idempotency enforcement (gateway-config) is unfinished/blocked by open verification obligation VOB-R-1 (gateway-config tool_health is currently UNKNOWN).
limitations_explained: VOB-R-1 is open: it is unverified whether the gateway-config tool is operational enough for set_capture_idempotency to execute and take effect reliably, so the actual re-enable action is outside this release's scope.
VOB-R-2 is open and required before production: re-enabling idempotency-key enforcement may reintroduce the original capture-latency problem that motivated CHG-77 (U-LATENCY-REGRESSION-RISK).

VOB-R-3 is open: it is unresolved whether the 4 open duplicate-capture orders found in E-08 represent the full extent of unresolved customer harm, or whether the underlying rate has changed since 09-10, and whether refunds for already-closed duplicates need separate handling.
No refund-execution tool exists in the tool surface, so customers already double-charged since 09-09 are not remediated by this release (SR-R4 is not feasible with available tools).
Ticket-volume normalization (SC-TICKETS-NORMALIZE) cannot be confirmed immediately; it requires several days/weeks of post-fix weekly ticket data before the duplicate-rate trend can be reassessed.
